contract: The operator binary initializes an admin journal, registers a log directory, and assigns orders-0.
Version 0 and version 1 raise metadata.version. A downgrade exits non-zero and leaves level 3.
Backup copies admin.journal. Restore into a new directory prints the same feature level and log directory.
limits: The binary does not listen, deploy, or copy partition bytes.
The workflow was run on Linux x86_64 only.
Caps are 16 replicas, 8 log directory names, and 8 features.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
